scenario: asking for help with train & coach travel
english_title: Recognising and Responding to Asking for Help With Train and Coach Travel
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: train & coach travel — asking for help with train & coach travel
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to asking for help with train & coach travel; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Mr Daniel to help her find the coach to the city.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nhờ anh Daniel giúp tìm xe khách vào thành phố.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Daniel, can you help me find the coach to the city?
turns.vietnamese: Daniel này, anh giúp tôi tìm xe khách vào thành phố được không?

turns.speaker: Mr Daniel
turns.english: Yes, it leaves from bay two.
turns.vietnamese: Được chứ, xe khởi hành từ khu vực số hai.
